fact: In 2025 the ANPDP of São Tomé and Príncipe, represented by members (Vogais) Maiquel do Espírito Santo and Dyazemar Pinheiro, visited the CNPD in Lisbon, and was given charge of the video-surveillance working group of the Lusophone data protection network at its meeting of 26 August 2025.
title: Relatório de Atividades 2025
publisher: Comissão Nacional de Proteção de Dados
